details.morale: At 8 hp or fewer, or when both Sootfinger and two warriors have fallen, withdraw toward the orchard. If cornered, offer stolen provisions for safe passage. Does not attack downed PCs.
details.sourceNotes: Base sheet excludes temporary spells. NPC hp uses the repository's approved heroic-NPC house rule. Burning hands is the level-3 bloodline bonus spell, not a purchased extra known spell. Carries NPC-standard rather than PC-equivalent wealth; unspent gear budget is not treasure.
details.tactics: Before the raid, cast mage armor once (3-hour duration): encounter-start AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14; 5 first-level slots remain. Do not also begin with shield active. On his first combat turn, cast shield if threatened (AC 21, touch 13, flat-footed 18 for 3 minutes), otherwise advance behind a warrior and use elemental ray. Burning hands deals 3d4 fire, DC 13 Reflex half, in a 15-ft. cone; use it on a worthwhile angle rather than allies or helpless targets. Elemental ray is a standard-action spell-like ranged touch attack at 30 ft., 1d6+1 fire, 5/day. Acid splash may deal fire through bloodline arcana; magic missile remains force damage. Do not grant fire immunity to his followers.
